name: evidence-kb
description: Single-plugin marketplace for evidence-kb: researched, reviewed knowledge bases in the Open Knowledge Format.

plugins.name: evidence-kb
plugins.description: Builds an evidence-based knowledge base about any topic in the repository, as an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundle, before implementation: plan, sourced findings, checkable recommendations, and an audit, with every phase challenged by independent reviewer subagents in a loop. Runs only when invoked explicitly.
